description: Bounded readiness preflight for California CDSS Child Care Centers and Family Child Care Homes resources.
redirect_policy: Catalog redirects are denied. Each resource HEAD may expose one signed S3 target, which is validated by host and resource path but never followed or retained with its query string.
retry: No retries, redirect follows, alternate resources, CSV bodies, API queries, or record requests.
checkpoint: The official catalog and both exact childcare resource HEAD responses are validated; resource redirects are not followed.
idempotency: Each observation uses a unique UUID directory and exclusive-create artifacts.
cancellation: Abort is checked before every request, while reading the bounded catalog page, and before publication.
retention_profile: Official catalog statements and privacy-safe resource response metadata only; zero provider rows, addresses, contacts, ZIP observations, or coordinates.
